statement: OpenAI's annualized revenue run rate is cited at over $40 billion as of August 2026, versus $25 billion in early 2026, about $20 billion at end of 2025 and $3.7 billion in late 2024.
why: Run-rate revenue at the largest model developer is the closest available read on how fast paid AI usage is growing, which underwrites its compute purchases.

impact.mechanism: Rising subscription and API revenue funds continued GPU capacity commitments by one of the largest compute buyers.

evidence.excerpt: the $40 billion ARR figure originates from Bloomberg reporting dated 2026-08-13/14 (outside this sweep's recency window) but is restated here in an Aug 27, 2026 secondary account without revision.

confidence.basis: Secondary account restating a mid-August Bloomberg figure; the company has not published these run-rate numbers directly.
